title: Scrum: roles, ceremonies, artefacts and what usually goes wrong

videos.script: Scrum fits in thirteen pages, and most teams that use it have never read them. {{guide}} The rules are few. Three accountabilities: a Product Owner, a Scrum Master, and the Developers. {{team}} Five events, and the first contains the other four. The Sprint is one month or less, and the next one starts at once. {{cycle}} Three artefacts, each with a commitment that says what it is for. The Sprint Backlog has a goal. The Increment has a Definition of Done. {{artefacts}} This lesson goes through each of them, reads a real burndown from the course's team, and names the six ways Scrum usually goes wrong. {{wrong}} It ends with the question an architect asks first: where does design go, in a framework that never mentions it? {{design}}
